description: This Swift source file defines classes and functions for voice push-to-talk functionality within a Mac application. It includes hotkey detection, speech recognition management, and session handling for capturing and processing voice input triggered by a specific hotkey (right Option key). The file implements monitoring of modifier keys, manages AVAudioEngine and speech recognition tasks, and coordinates UI and application state updates related to voice input.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: Singleton class that monitors global and local keyboard events to detect right Option key presses and releases to trigger voice recording sessions.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalk
classes.description: Actor managing the voice recognition session, handling starting, stopping, and finalizing speech recognition based on hotkey status, with detailed session and recognition management features.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables hotkey monitoring for push-to-talk functionality.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Sets up global and local event monitors for modifier key changes.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Removes event monitors and resets hotkey state.

methods.name: handleFlagsChanged
methods.description: Handles flag change events, updating internal modifier state.

methods.name: updateModifierState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on current modifier keys and triggers speech recognition start or stop accordingly.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Initiates the speech recognition session when the hotkey is held down, including permission checks, configuration setup, and starting recognition.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Terminates an ongoing recognition session, finalizing or discarding recognition results based on whether any speech was detected.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognition engine and handles live transcription.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes partial or final transcription results, updating the UI and session state.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Completes the recognition session, uploading final transcripts and updating UI state.

methods.name: makeConfig
methods.description: Constructs configuration data for recognition sessions based on application state.
